description: Publish a key/value entry to BrewPage. Creates a KV store; the entry is addressed by (namespace, id, key). Repository defaults: 1 MiB per value, 1,000 keys per store. Returns its primary share link and owner token.

deliveryMode.description: Optional delivery choice for a fresh publication, independent of password/namespace. Public non-sites normally default to path (Promotion); public HTML may automatically choose subdomain for browser features. Fresh sites and non-public content require subdomain. An existing dedup winner keeps its actual mode and URL.

key.description: KV key (first part of the (namespace, id, key) addressing tuple)

namespace.description: Optional. Omit to generate an unlisted namespace: anyone with its unpassworded link can read it, but it is excluded from gallery/search. Pass a custom namespace to group unlisted content, or pass `public` ONLY when the user explicitly wants gallery/search eligibility. Password-protected content stays excluded; unlisted, protected or otherwise ineligible native responses carry noindex; eligible public HTML, sites and files may permit indexing.

ownerToken.description: Existing owner token to group this KV store under the same owner as previous content

password.description: Optional password to protect the KV store

tags.description: Optional tags for the KV entry

ttlDays.description: Requested TTL in days (1-30, default 15). Backend owner caps and eligible automatic extensions can affect expiry; use returned expiresAt.

name: publish_kv
